ops.sql: SELECT p.Package_ID, p.ea_guid, p.Name FROM t_package p WHERE p.Name = 'FBT-NASAZENI'
SELECT o.Object_ID, o.ea_guid, o.Name, o.Object_Type FROM t_object o WHERE o.Name = 'FBT Nasazeni prvek 1'
SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Name, o.CreatedDate FROM t_object o WHERE o.Name LIKE 'FB nas-03%' OR (o.Object_Type = 'Artifact' AND o.Name LIKE 'FB nas-%')
